item.title: Re: “Anti foundation” SCP
item.content:encoded:
You've got two basic problems:

1) What exactly is the goal of the "anti-foundations"? Are they trying to destroy The Foundation from within, steal SCPs, steal information, and/or slow it down? If they just worship the deity and only hate The Foundation, that's not in and of itself enough to create an MTF to take the people out. The most likely event is that they would tag the personnel involved and round them up, keeping them under control until they can figure out what's going on.

If they've all been marked MIA, it's likely that they would be found out during debriefing, something that The Foundation does a thorough job of considering that they deal with shapeshifters, possessors, and other infiltrators. Someone who was marked as MIA but came back would be seen as very suspicious under The Foundation's circumstances, and so the debriefing would be very thorough. As such, they would likely be caught by agents with no need for an MTF.

Unless, of course, they gained some sort of combat enhancement through their experience…

2) There either is an entity of some sort or there isn't. Since there is an effect, there has to be an entity of some sort. As such you need to actually define it. The fewer the mysteries the better, and if it's just a mystery for the sake of a mystery, that won't cut it.

item.title: “Anti foundation” SCP
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: This SCP is an unkown entity that goes to members of the foundation, this SCP only goes to personnel that have been marked “missing in action” (MIA). When this entity finds a target, it will brainwash the target into hating the foundation. Personnel effected by this entity band together and form groups known as “anti foundations”.

Central Narrative: This SCP will make personnel think they have been saved, the personnel that are effected warhsip this SCP and it is unkown if it knows what it is causing. Upon the discovery of SCP, mobile Task Force Omega-22 “copycat catchers” was created to stop the anti foundation from gaining power.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: It is thought to be real, but no one knows if the god/SCP even exists or if something else is going on.
